evidence.quote: I continue to believe that open capital markets offer significant benefits in terms of greater efficiency and improved standards of living
at most, capital controls should be seen as just one of many tools that can be used to manage capital inflows, and one to be used only in particularly challenging situations.
This feature of the international system inhibits the process of global rebalancing and could restrain the current recovery.
